value.answer: Honestly, the sources don't agree on one winner. My pick is the 2026 Kia Carnival Hybrid. The Weekly Driver, the newest review I found, calls it the best overall minivan for most families. It gets about 32 mpg combined and has a 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty, the best in the class. U.S. News has the Honda Odyssey on top and Edmunds has the Sienna, so if fuel economy or how it drives matters most to you, those two are worth a look too.
